node_types.label: Trigger
node_types.description: Starts the workflow when a record changes or on a schedule. A workflow has one Trigger.

output_help.next: Taken once this step is done.

config.name: mode
config.label: Starts on
config.help: A record event starts one journey the moment a record is saved. A schedule takes everyone who matches, on a rhythm, and starts a journey for each.

config.name: subject_doctype
config.label: Subject
config.help: Which record this workflow watches. It decides every field offered below and in every node after this one, so set it first.

config.name: event
config.label: Event
config.help: Which save starts the journey.

config.name: schedule
config.label: Repeats
config.help: How often everyone matching Only when is gathered up: once on a date, or every day, week or month.

config.name: schedule_date
config.label: On date
config.help: The day the single run happens.

config.name: schedule_weekdays
config.label: On days
config.help: The days of the week it runs.

config.name: schedule_month_day
config.label: On day
config.help: The day of the month it runs. Last day follows each month's own length.

config.name: schedule_time
config.label: At
config.help: Time of day the schedule runs, on the site's own clock. Blank runs it at midnight.

config.name: schedule_start
config.label: Starts on
config.help: No run before this day. Blank starts at the next occurrence.

config.name: schedule_end
config.label: Ends on
config.help: No run after this day. Blank repeats until the workflow is suspended.

config.name: vertical
config.label: Vertical
config.help: Narrows this workflow to one vertical. Leave it blank for any — and blank is what scopes the pickers below to everything.

config.name: group
config.label: Group
config.help: Narrows this workflow to one group. Leave it blank for any.

config.name: program
config.label: Program
config.help: Narrows this workflow to one programme. Leave it blank for any. Set it and every picker below offers only what that programme can reach.

config.name: working_set
config.label: Fields used
config.help: Trims every picker in this workflow to the handful of fields it really works with. Nothing is blocked — each picker keeps a Show all fields link.

config.name: predicate
config.label: Only when
config.help: Who this workflow is for. On a schedule it is the cohort. Values come from Subject above — choose that first or there is nothing to test.

config.name: once_per_subject
config.label: Only once per patient
config.help: Enrols each patient once and never again, however often they match. A schedule re-selects everyone who matches on every run, so without this a monthly journey sends the same welcome every month.

config.name: retrigger
config.label: When it fires again
config.help: What happens when another record matches while this patient's run is still going. Leave it empty to ignore the new record. Run alongside starts a separate run for each record. Restart stops the waiting run and starts a new one. Saving the same record again never starts a second run.

config.name: without_lead
config.label: Also run without a lead
config.help: Off: a record with no lead starts nothing. On: it starts this workflow too. A call uses the vertical, group and program of the number it came in on. You can't publish a node that works on the lead, such as Create Task.

node_types.label: Route
node_types.description: Sends the journey down the first branch whose condition matches. If none match, it goes down Otherwise.

config.name: routes
config.label: Routes
config.help: One branch per condition, tried top to bottom. Each row draws its own handle on the canvas — wire it there.

node_types.label: Sample
node_types.description: Splits leads into groups by percentage, for a trial or a control group. A lead always lands in the same group.

output_help.remainder: The share left after every arm.

config.name: arms
config.label: Arms
config.help: Each arm takes the share you give it. They need not add up to a hundred — whatever is left over takes Remainder.

node_types.label: Set Variables
node_types.description: Saves values for later nodes to read. To change who owns a lead, use Assign to User.

output_help.next: Taken once this step is done.

config.name: assign
config.label: Values
config.help: Names and their values, as one expression. Every name set here is offered to the nodes below this one.

node_types.label: Wait
node_types.description: Pauses the journey until an event happens, a set time passes, or whichever comes first.

output_help.event: The outcome this Wait listens for arrived.
output_help.next: Taken once this step is done.
output_help.timeout: The time ran out before that outcome arrived.

config.name: mode
config.label: Mode
config.help: What ends the wait: something happening, a length of time, a moment on the calendar, or whichever of an event and a timeout comes first. It also decides which handles this node draws.

config.name: source_node
config.label: Waiting on
config.help: Which earlier node this wait listens to. Only nodes that report an outcome AND always run before this one are offered — wire this node up on the canvas and they appear.

config.name: event_name
config.label: Outcome
config.help: Which of that node's outcomes wakes the journey. Choose Waiting on first — this list is that node's own.

config.name: accepts
config.label: Accepts
config.help: Optional. Lifts values out of the arriving event into the journey so later nodes can read them — each entry maps a path in the event to a name you choose. Blank means wake me, I need nothing from it.

config.name: duration
config.label: Wait for
config.help: How long the journey waits before moving on.

config.name: until_time
config.label: Wait until
config.help: A moment on the calendar, or a date the run is carrying — choose a value to wait for the patient's own appointment or review date.

node_types.label: End
node_types.description: Ends the journey.

node_types.label: Assign to User
node_types.description: Changes who owns the lead, or a record this journey created, such as a ticket.

output_help.nobody: No one could be assigned: no user resolved, or the pool had nobody to give.

config.name: assignee_mode
config.label: Assign to
config.help: Name one person here, take whoever an earlier node worked out, or hand it to a pool and let its rota decide.

config.name: target_doctype
config.label: Write to
config.help: Which record gets the assignee: the patient's lead, the record that started the journey, or one this journey raised, such as its ticket. Blank is the lead.

config.name: only_if_unassigned
config.label: Only if nobody holds it
config.help: Ticked: a record someone already holds keeps that person, and the node leaves by assigned. Unticked: the record is assigned as set below.

config.name: assign_mode
config.label: Mode
config.help: Assign adds this person alongside anyone already on the record. Reassign clears the others first.

config.name: assign_to_user
config.label: User
config.help: Only people entitled to this workflow's grain are offered — widen the Trigger's grain to see more.

config.name: assignee_variable
config.label: Take the user from
config.help: The value must hold a user's login id. Values come from the nodes above this one.

config.name: assignment_rule
config.label: Pool
config.help: Who is in the pool and whose turn it is are the rule's own settings, under Assignment Rule. This node only says when to draw from it. Pick a rule made for the record in Write to.

config.name: assign_note
config.label: Note
config.help: Optional line shown with the assignment, so the person knows why it reached them. A pool uses the rule's own description instead.

node_types.label: Distribute
node_types.description: Gives a record nobody owns to the next person in a pool. Place it right after the Trigger or a Route branch.

output_help.nobody: No one could be assigned: no user resolved, or the pool had nobody to give.
output_help.closed: The pool keeps hours and none is open right now (shift, holiday or leave).

config.name: target_doctype
config.label: Write to
config.help: Which record is given out: the patient's lead, the record that started the journey, or one this journey raised, such as its ticket. Blank is the lead.

config.name: assignment_rule
config.label: Pool
config.help: Who is in the pool, their weights, daily caps, shifts and whose turn it is are the rule's own settings, under Assignment Rule. Tick Assigned by a workflow on it so a save never assigns from it. When no shift is open the record leaves by closed. Pick a rule made for the record in Write to.

config.name: only_when
config.label: Only when
config.help: Which leads this node distributes. Any lead field can be tested, including section fields such as UTM Disease. Leave it blank for every lead that reaches it.

config.name: wait_for_checkin
config.label: Wait for a rep to check in
config.help: Off: a lead nobody can take leaves by nobody, or by closed when no shift is open. On: it waits inside this node and is distributed the moment a pool member checks in, a shift opens, or a member starts or closes a task.

config.name: reassign_after
config.label: Reassign after
config.help: Blank does nothing. Set, a lead this node assigns whose holder has not worked it by then (started their task, or called it) goes, with the task, to the next rep the pool can give it to. Credit Weighted pools only. Works only when Write to is the lead.

config.name: reassign_limit
config.label: Move at most
config.help: How many times one lead may move under Reassign after. Blank moves it at most 3 times.

node_types.label: Create Task
node_types.description: Creates a task on the lead.

output_help.next: Taken once this step is done.

config.name: task_type
config.label: Task Type
config.help: Decides the task's own fields and who may complete it. Task types are set up under Taxonomy.

config.name: assignee_mode
config.label: Assign to
config.help: Name one person here, or take whoever an earlier node worked out. Leave empty to carry the trigger's assignee forward.

config.name: assign_to_user
config.label: User
config.help: Only people entitled to this workflow's grain are offered — widen the Trigger's grain to see more.

config.name: assignee_variable
config.label: Take the user from
config.help: The value must hold a user's login id. Values come from the nodes above this one.

config.name: subject_mode
config.label: Subject from
config.help: Type the subject, or build it from values the run is carrying. Leave it unset and the task is named after its type.

config.name: subject_text
config.label: Subject
config.help: Exactly what the rep reads on their task list.

config.name: subject_expression
config.label: Subject Expression
config.help: Must produce text, e.g. "Call " + ctx["crm_lead.first_name"].

config.name: priority
config.label: Priority
config.help: How urgent this is on the rep's list. Leave it unset and the task keeps the priority the record itself defaults to.

config.name: description_mode
config.label: Note from
config.help: Type the note, or build it from values the run is carrying.

config.name: description
config.label: Note
config.help: A line of instruction shown under the subject, e.g. "Patient has not uploaded the documents". Leave it blank and the task carries no note.

config.name: description_expression
config.label: Note Expression
config.help: Must produce text, e.g. "Replied: " + ctx["whatsapp_message.message"].

config.name: allow_duplicate_tasks
config.label: Allow duplicate tasks
config.help: Off (the default): if this node already has an open task of this type for the patient, it is reused instead of raising another. On: every fire raises a new task, even when one is still open.

config.name: due_mode
config.label: Due date from
config.help: Leave it unset for the task type's own default due date.

config.name: due_from
config.label: Take the date from
config.help: A date carried by the run — the patient's appointment, or a date an earlier node worked out.

config.name: due_expression
config.label: Due Expression
config.help: Date arithmetic, e.g. add_days(ctx["crm_lead.creation"], 7).

config.name: due_delay
config.label: Due after
config.help: How long after this node runs the task falls due.

node_types.label: Update Field
node_types.description: Sets values on fields that automation is allowed to change.

output_help.next: Taken once this step is done.

config.name: target_doctype
config.label: Write to
config.help: Which record is written — the patient's lead, or the record that started the journey.

config.name: updates
config.label: Fields to set
config.help: One row per field. Only fields an operator has allowed automation to write are offered; the rest are set up under Automation Fields.

config.name: create_contact
config.label: Create contact if none exists
config.help: Off (the default): a contact is only linked when one already matches the phone or email. On: when none matches, one is made. Used only when this node writes to a contact or sets a contact field.

node_types.label: Create Contact
node_types.description: Finds the patient's contact, or creates one. It uses the lead when there is one, otherwise a phone number or email from the journey.

output_help.found: An existing record was found and is used.
output_help.created: No record was found, so a new one was made.
output_help.not_found: No record was found, and the node was set not to make one.

config.name: value_from
config.label: Number or email from
config.help: Used when the journey has no lead. The value must hold a phone number or an email address. Values come from the nodes above this one.

config.name: if_not_found
config.label: If none is found
config.help: Create makes a contact, named after the lead, or after the number when there is no lead. Do not create leaves by not found.

node_types.label: Create Ticket
node_types.description: Finds the contact's ticket on a team, or creates one, and links the record that started the journey. A ticket it finds keeps its status and owner.

output_help.found: An existing record was found and is used.
output_help.created: No record was found, so a new one was made.
output_help.found_closed: A record closed within the set time was found and is used as it is.
output_help.not_found: No record was found, and the node was set not to make one.

config.name: contact_from
config.label: Contact from
config.help: The contact whose ticket this is, such as the one a Create Contact node found. Values come from the nodes above this one.

config.name: team
config.label: Team
config.help: Only this team's tickets are looked in, so a patient of two teams keeps two tickets. A ticket this node makes gets this team. Tick Assigned by a workflow on the team's Assignment Rule so the ticket is given out by an Assign to User node, not on save.

config.name: reuse_categories
config.label: Reuse a ticket that is
config.help: A ticket whose status falls in one of these groups is reused. Leave it empty to make a new ticket every time.

config.name: reopen_within
config.label: Reuse if closed within
config.help: A ticket closed within this time is reused, and its status is left as it is. Leave it blank to never reuse a closed ticket.

config.name: if_not_found
config.label: If none is found
config.help: Create makes a ticket from Fields when created. Do not create leaves by not found.

config.name: create_fields
config.label: Fields when created
config.help: Written only when this node makes the ticket. A ticket it finds is never changed. Only fields an operator has allowed automation to write are offered.

node_types.label: Append Child Row
node_types.description: Adds a row to a section on the lead.

output_help.next: Taken once this step is done.

config.name: child_table
config.label: Section
config.help: Which of the lead's sections gains a row.

config.name: set_fields
config.label: Fields to set
config.help: One row per field on the new row.

node_types.label: Upsert Child Row
node_types.description: Updates the lead's row in a section, or adds one if there is none.

output_help.next: Taken once this step is done.

config.name: child_table
config.label: Section
config.help: Which of the lead's sections is written. How its row is found is the section's own declaration, not this node's.

config.name: set_fields
config.label: Fields to set
config.help: One row per field. Increment by adds to what the row already holds.

node_types.label: Call API
node_types.description: Calls a configured API endpoint and saves parts of the reply for later nodes.

output_help.succeeded: The call came back as this node's success condition expects.
output_help.failed: The step could not be done; the run log says why.

config.name: webhook_endpoint
config.label: Endpoint
config.help: Where the call goes, and the credential it goes with. Endpoints are curated under Webhook — this node cannot name a URL of its own.

config.name: webhook_payload_source
config.label: Send
config.help: Send the whole record, or write the body yourself.

config.name: request_body
config.label: Request Body
config.help: Write $ctx.<name> anywhere, at any depth, to drop in a value the run is carrying.

config.name: preview_lead
config.label: Test with
config.help: Whose record the Test call below is built from. Only patients inside this workflow's grain are offered. Leave it blank and the most recently updated one is used.

config.name: capture
config.label: Capture
config.help: Names for the parts of the response later nodes should be able to read. Press Test call to see a real response and pick from it.

config.name: success_when
config.label: Succeeded when
config.help: Which responses count as success and take the Succeeded branch. Leave it blank and any 2xx does.

node_types.label: Create Note
node_types.description: Adds a note to the timeline of the lead, or of a record this journey holds.

output_help.next: Taken once this step is done.

config.name: target_doctype
config.label: Write to
config.help: Which record gets the note: the patient's lead, the record that started the journey, or one this journey raised, such as its ticket. Blank is the lead.

config.name: comment_mode
config.label: Text from
config.help: Type the note, or build it from values the run is carrying.

config.name: comment_text
config.label: Text
config.help: Exactly what appears on the timeline.

config.name: comment_expression
config.label: Expression
config.help: Must produce text, e.g. "Called " + ctx["crm_lead.first_name"].

node_types.label: Send WhatsApp
node_types.description: Sends a WhatsApp template from the right account, then branches on whether it reached the patient.

output_help.sent: The message was handed to the provider.
output_help.failed: The step could not be done; the run log says why.

config.name: contact_number
config.label: Mobile Number
config.help: Picked, never typed — a typed number is how a message reaches the wrong person.

config.name: whatsapp_template
config.label: Template
config.help: Only approved templates can be sent. They are set up under WhatsApp Templates, and the template decides which values are asked for below.

config.name: buttons
config.label: Buttons offered
config.help: Buttons this message offers. Each one draws its own branch on a Wait placed after this node, so a tap can be routed by wiring rather than by a condition.

config.name: template_values
config.label: Template Values
config.help: One row per blank in the template. Every blank needs a row — a missing one sends the patient an empty space.

config.name: document_variable
config.label: Document placeholder
config.help: The name the template's own header gives its document, e.g. pdfLink. Copy it exactly — the provider matches by name, not by position. Leave it blank when the message carries no document.

config.name: document_file
config.label: Document to attach
config.help: Which file goes into that header — pick the document an earlier Generate Document node produced. A file that is still private, or gone, sends nothing and takes the Failed branch.

node_types.label: Send Email
node_types.description: Sends an email from a template, then branches on whether it could be sent.

output_help.sent: The message was handed to the provider.
output_help.failed: The step could not be done; the run log says why.

config.name: recipient_mode
config.label: Recipient from
config.help: Take the address from a value the run carries, type it, or build it. Anything that is not a valid email address takes the Failed branch.

config.name: email_recipient
config.label: Recipient
config.help: The value must hold an email address. Values come from the nodes above this one.

config.name: email_address
config.label: Address
config.help: Typed exactly. Separate several addresses with commas.

config.name: email_expression
config.label: Recipient Expression
config.help: Must produce an email address, e.g. ctx["crm_lead.email"].

config.name: email_template
config.label: Template
config.help: There is no compose box — every message goes through the org's templates, set up under Email Template.

config.name: template_values
config.label: Template Values
config.help: One row per variable the template names. Every one needs a row.

node_types.label: AI Voice Call
node_types.description: Places an AI voice call, then branches on whether the provider accepted it.

output_help.placed: The call was handed to the provider.
output_help.failed: The step could not be done; the run log says why.

config.name: connection
config.label: Voice account
config.help: The provider account this call is placed on. Everything below belongs to it, so choose it first. Accounts are set up under AI Voice Account.

config.name: agent_id
config.label: Agent
config.help: Which agent speaks. Agents are created on the provider, not here — press Refresh after adding one.
config.gate_text: Pick a voice account first — the agents belong to it.
config.empty_text: This account has no agents yet. Create one on the provider, then Refresh.

config.name: agent_values
config.label: What the agent says
config.help: One row per blank the agent's script names. An unfilled blank is spoken aloud to the patient as it is written.

config.name: contact_number
config.label: Mobile Number
config.help: Picked, never typed — a typed number is how a call reaches the wrong person.

config.name: from_override
config.label: From number
config.help: Only numbers this account really owns are offered. Leave it blank to use the account's own.
config.gate_text: Pick a voice account first — the numbers belong to it.
config.empty_text: This account owns no numbers. The agent's own default is used.

config.name: bypass_guardrails
config.label: Skip the agent's calling hours
config.help: Dials as soon as the journey reaches this node instead of waiting for the agent's configured calling hours. Useful for testing a journey end to end.

node_types.label: Generate Document
node_types.description: Makes a PDF from a template for this patient, and reports when it is ready to send.

output_help.failed: The step could not be done; the run log says why.

config.name: document_template
config.label: Template
config.help: The document's layout and wording. Templates are authored under Web Template, and the one you pick decides which values are asked for below.

config.name: document_values
config.label: Document Values
config.help: One row per input the template declares. Every one needs a row — a missing one leaves a hole in the document.

config.name: file_name
config.label: File name
config.help: What the document is called when the patient receives it. Leave it blank and it is named after its own record.
